title: Allow usernames that start with a digit

findings.label: intended
findings.why: The PR allows usernames starting with digits, so '1user' now passes validation and returns 201 instead of 400.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The test was changed from '1user' to '_user', but the observed error shows a new email validation error appearing that the PR description does not mention.

doppel.summary: The PR correctly allows digit-starting usernames, but an unrelated email validation error appears in the test output.
